title: Top 13 Gadgets Imprescindibles para Deportistas en Amazon

hook.text: Monitorea cada movimiento. Controla tu salud al instante. Corrige tu forma de correr. Escucha en cualquier clima. Mide tu frecuencia cardíaca.

introduction.greeting: Suscríbete y encuentra los links en el primer comentario.

sections.title: Garmin Venu 2S
content: Lo que pocos descubren del Garmin Venu 2S es su capacidad para prolongar la batería hasta diez días en modo smartwatch, manteniendo constante medición de salud y actividad física, todo desde una pantalla AMOLED brillante.
Su precio actual en Amazon ronda los... 150 dólares. ¡Link en el primer comentario!
features: Suit your style with a smartwatch that's available in two colors and features a bright AMOLED display.
Get an uninterrupted picture of your health with battery life of up to 10 days in smartwatch mode and up to 7 hours in GPS mode with music, plus battery saver mode

Know your body better with extensive health monitoring features including health snapshot, Body Battery energy levels, sleep score, fitness age, stress tracking and more (this device is intended to be an estimation of your activity and metrics; it is not a medical device)

Use preloaded workouts that include cardio, yoga, strength, HIIT and Pilates, create your own in the Garmin Connect app on your compatible smartphone, or try Garmin Coach free adaptive training plans to help you prepare for your next running challenge

Download up to 650 songs to your watch, including playlists from Spotify, Amazon Music or Deezer (may require a premium subscription), and connect with wireless headphones (not included) for phone-free listening

sections.title: Theragun Mini
content: El Theragun Mini es un dispositivo de masaje portátil ideal para aliviar tensiones musculares. Su diseño compacto permite llevarlo a cualquier lugar y disfrutar de sus beneficios en cualquier momento.
Su precio actual en Amazon ronda los 220 dólares. ¡Link en el primer comentario!

sections.title: HidrateSpark PRO
content: La botella HidrateSpark PRO te ayuda a mantenerte hidratado con su tecnología SipSense que rastrea cada sorbo. Además, nunca la perderás gracias a su integración con Apple Find My.
Su precio actual en Amazon ronda los 80 dólares. ¡Link en el primer comentario!
features: AUTOMATIC HYDRATION TRACKING – Clinically accurate SipSense technology tracks every sip.
APPLE FIND MY – Never lose your bottle again. Built in Apple Find My helps you locate it in seconds.
PERSONALIZED HYDRATION GOALS - The app recommends a smart hydration goal unique to you to ensure optimal hydration.
UP TO 21 DAY BATTERY LIFE - Best in class battery life allows you to stay hyrdrated on the go.
DRINK REMINDERS - A 360-Degree sensor glow, sounds, and app alerts keep hydration front of mind.

sections.title: Wahoo TICKR Fit
content: El Wahoo TICKR Fit es un monitor de frecuencia cardíaca que proporciona métricas precisas de entrenamiento. Con tecnología dual-band, se conecta fácilmente a tus dispositivos favoritos para monitorear tu rendimiento.
Su precio actual en Amazon ronda los 90 dólares. ¡Link en el primer comentario!
features: CONNECT HEART RATE TO YOUR FAVORITE TRAINING APPS AND DEVICES - Proven technology delivers accurate heart rate and calories to the Wahoo Fitness and other popular training apps

HEART RATE, CALORIE, and TIME TRACKING - TICKR FIT measures vital workout metrics, including heart rate, calorie burn, and workout duration in real-time with the Wahoo Fitness app. These metrics can also be sent to compatible third-party apps that track these metrics
DUAL-BAND TECHNOLOGY - Equipped with ANT plus and bluetooth smart capabilities for a wireless connection to both smartphones and GPS devices
VISIBLE CONNECTION - One LED light shows visual confirmation of the TICKR connection status via Bluetooth and / or ANT plus : searching for a connections, connecting, and reading heart rate
ADVANCED PERFORMANCE MATERIAL STRAP - Designed to fit comfortably around your arm, yet fit securely during intense activity. Two adjustable bands included (Small and large)

sections.title: MOOV Now
content: "¿Quieres mejorar tu salud? MOOV Now es tu solución." Este rastreador monitorea tu ritmo cardíaco y más, todo el día, para ayudarte a vivir mejor.
"Su precio actual en Amazon ronda los..." 35 dólares. ¡Link en el primer comentario!
features: 【All-day Health Monitor】The fitness tracker watch will automatically track your real-time heart rate, blood pressure and blood oxygen throughout the day to help you better understand your health. Equipped with a high-performance chipset, the fitness tracker automatically analyzes your overall sleep quality (deep/light/wake time) at night and gives you a nightly sleep score in the app to help you adjust your lifestyle and make you healthier.

【Smart Notification Remider】 With Bluetooth connection to your phone, it can support incoming calls/text alerts/APP message notifications (WhatsApp/Facebook/Instagram etc.), you will never miss your important messages. With the fitness watch, you can also perform sedentary reminder, water reminder, alarm clock, stopwatch, remote control photo, find devices, etc. to make your life healthier and smarter.

【25 Sports Modes】 Fitness tracker supports 25 professional sports modes, you can choose any number of sports modes as your exclusive sports modes in the app, such as walking, running, dancing, yoga, etc. and track your steps, heart rate, distance and calories to help you stay motivated, accomplish your sports goals, record your sports data, and make your sports more scientific.

【Long Battery Life】The fitness watch uses magnetic fast charging to provide a better battery life experience. It takes 1-2 hours to fully charge and can be used for up to 7 days of regular use and 15 days of standby. Compatible mobile phone system: android5.0 (inclusive) and IOS9.0 (inclusive) or above.

【1.1" AMOLED Touch Color Screen】AMOLED HD touch color screen is designed with clear and bright display, providing you with high quality touch and visual experience. This smartwatch includes a large number of original dials and supports custom dials.

sections.title: Hyperice Hypersphere
content: Packed with power. Perfect for travel, the TSA carry-on approved Hypersphere Go targets your tightest areas with precision to help you move better wherever you roam. The device wil
Su precio actual en Amazon ronda los... 109 dólares. ¡Link en el primer comentario!
features: Packed with power. Perfect for travel, the TSA carry-on approved Hypersphere Go targets your tightest areas with precision to help you move better wherever you roam. The device will turn off after 10 minutes of use. The device will show 1 red light and 2 green lights when the device is fully charged.

Take it everywhere. The Hypersphere Go is a massage ball that fits into the palm of your hand. With three speeds of vibration—low, medium, and high—you can roll it over your muscles, wherever they need some loosening up. Our Hypersphere devices only require USB-A to USB-C charging connection.

Compact and powerful. The compact, textured, vibrating Hypersphere Go is an affordable, travel-friendly massage ball that fitness enthusiasts swear by. Ideal for rolling out after a workout, but also great for those long workdays spending too much time sitting down.

When the device is charging, the first red light will stay solid while the rest of the green lights blink in order. Please note that the first red charging light will never turn green, and this is normal. To turn it on, press down on the power button for three seconds until the LED lights illuminate then release the button. Press it once more to select the desired vibration level.

Mobility roll. Increase mobility by loosening muscles, tendons and joints pre-workout & post-workout. 3 Speeds of vibration, 2 hour battery life, 1 lb, TSA approved carry-on. The device will turn off after 10 minutes of use. The device will show 1 red light and 2 green lights when the device is fully charged.

sections.title: Form Swim Goggles
content: Get faster in the pool and open water with FORM Smart Swim 2 Goggles and the FORM app (iOS and Android). Designed for triathletes and swimmers of all ages and abilities by sport sc
Su precio actual en Amazon ronda los... 199 dólares. ¡Link en el primer comentario!
features: Get faster in the pool and open water with FORM Smart Swim 2 Goggles and the FORM app (iOS and Android). Designed for triathletes and swimmers of all ages and abilities by sport scientists and former Olympic athletes.

Core Features: No subscription needed. See real-time metrics with our AR display as in-goggle sensors track your data for instant feedback and detailed review in the FORM app. SwimStraight compass keeps you on course. Track heart rate, time, distance, pace, stroke rate/count, calories, and more. Share with Strava, TrainingPeaks, TriDot, Apple Health, Final Surge, and pair with Garmin/Apple Watches.

Precision Engineering & Design: Standard polycarbonate lens with industry-leading anti-fog coating, integrated optical heart rate monitor (97% accuracy), proprietary eye seals, 14 hours of swim time on a single charge, and 5 interchangeable nose bridges. Backed by a 2-year warranty.

Premium Features (1-Month Free Trial Included; Continue from $9.99/mo): Premium includes: (1) 1,500+ workouts and 45 training plans with motivating lap-by-lap instructions in your goggles. (2) HeadCoach - in-goggle visual coaching and resources to enhance your technique. (3) Script - import workouts from TrainingPeaks and TriDot, or photograph a workout to add it to the FORM Workout Builder.
Race approved by World Triathlon, USA Triathlon, British Triathlon, PTO, and SuperTri.

sections.title: Jaybird Vista
content: Los Jaybird Vista ofrecen hasta 6 horas de reproducción inalámbrica, con carga rápida de 10 minutos para una hora adicional. Son resistentes al agua y el sudor, ideales para cualquier clima y actividad deportiva.
Su precio actual en Amazon ronda los 50 dólares. ¡Link en el primer comentario!
features: 6 HOURS OF PLAYTIME: Rechargeable battery provides 6 hours of bluetooth wireless play time on a single charge. 10 minutes of fast charging provides a full hour of play time
SWEAT & WATERPROOF: Sweatproof and waterproof (IPX7) protection for gym and fitness workouts and running in all weather conditions

SPORT FIT: The Jaybird Tarah includes ultra-soft and flexible silicone ear gels, which provide incredible comfort and a secure fit, permitting you to enjoy your music without distractions from your earbuds
PREMIUM SOUND WITH CUSTOM EQ: Uncompromising sound quality with customizable EQ through the Jaybird iOS and Android app (Google Fast Pair enabled)
MUSIC & CALLS: Integrated microphone allows users to manage phone calls and control and listen to music, without interrupting gym workout or run

sections.title: TRX GO Suspension
content: El TRX GO es un gimnasio portátil ideal para entrenamientos rápidos y efectivos en cualquier lugar. Incluye correas de suspensión, anclajes interiores y exteriores, y una bolsa de transporte.
Su precio actual en Amazon ronda los 140 dólares. ¡Link en el primer comentario!
features: Mesh Nylon Strap and foam Handles
Imported

PORTABLE HOME GYM: TRX GO is a lightweight Suspension Trainer that is easy to use as a home workout system or take on the go. It’s easy to pack for travel and perfect for fun, fast, and effective workouts anywhere and anytime in as little as 20 minutes per day.

BEYOND GYM STRAPS: This set includes a Suspension Training Strap, Indoor/Outdoor Anchors, and a Mesh Carry Bag. Download the TRX Training App for hundreds of workouts by world-class trainers. TRX GO is the ideal home gym complement for all types of training.

SEE THE RESULTS: Bodyweight Suspension Training has been proven to increase muscular activation, reduce injury risk, and accelerate results. TRX allows you to build lean muscle, burn fat, increase range of motion, and improve your performance in life and sports.

sections.title: WHOOP Strap 4.0
content: El WHOOP Strap 4.0 ofrece monitorización continua de salud, desde sueño hasta frecuencia cardíaca. Incluye membresía de 12 meses y un PowerPack inalámbrico.
Su precio actual en Amazon ronda los 239 dólares. ¡Link en el primer comentario!
features: HSA/FSA ELIGIBLE: All 12-month WHOOP memberships and WHOOP battery packs are eligible for HSA/FSA reimbursement.

EVERYTHING YOU NEED IS INCLUDED: Your WHOOP purchase includes a 12-month WHOOP Peak membership, a WHOOP 5.0 device, a SuperKnit band, and a waterproof* Wireless PowerPack for continuous data collection

CONTINUOUS MONITORING: WHOOP monitors your most important metrics, including sleep, heart rate, blood oxygen, stress, menstrual cycle, VO2 max, and Pace of Aging*–providing 24/7 insights to optimize fitness, recovery, and overall health.

A HOLISTIC VIEW OF YOUR HEALTH: Understand your baseline vitals like heart rate and skin temperature with Health Monitor, pinpoint your stressors with Stress Monitor, and get daily recommendations for sleep, strain, and recovery.

BUILD YOUR BEST ROUTINE: Get insights and guidance on how your daily habits impact your long-term health with Healthspan—a powerful new way to quantify your physiological age and slow your Pace of Aging.

sections.title: NURVV Run Insoles
content: Your own personal built-in running coach: La app NURVV te guía para correr más rápido mientras evitas lesiones gracias a sus plantillas conectadas que analizan tu forma de correr.
Su precio actual en Amazon ronda los... X dólares. ¡Link en el primer comentario!
features: <b> YOUR OWN PERSONAL BUILT-IN RUNNING COACH: <b/>NURVV coaching app guides you through your run, helping you run faster and more efficiently - indoors or outdoors

<b> AVOID NEEDLESS RUNNING INJURIES: <b/> Connected insoles help you improve your running form and prevent foot, ankle, knee, hip and back injuries before they happen. Developed by leading biomechanics experts and used by Olympians and professional athletes

<b> MEASURE YOUR RUNNING HEALTH AND IMPROVE YOUR PERFORMANCE: <b/> NURVV Run measures unique metrics: pronation, footstrike, step-length, balance and cadence. In addition to pace, distance, time and calories burned

<b> PROGRESS YOUR RUNNING USING AWARD-WINNING TECHNOLOGY: <b/> Two insoles with 32 precision sensors analyse every aspect of your running to ensure you run at your optimum level. Built-in GPS measures distance with world-leading accuracy. A complete picture of your running and how to improve

<b> COMPATIBLE WITH IOS, ANDROID, GARMIN AND APPLE WATCH, HEART RATE MONITORS, STRAVA AND APPLE HEALTH: <b/> Link your NURVV Run connected insoles to your favourite devices. Download the NURVV app and get real-time data on demand. Join the rapidly growing NURVV community on Strava

sections.title: Polar Verity Sense
content: 71% Polyester, 29% Spandex
Su precio actual en Amazon ronda los... 105 dólares. ¡Link en el primer comentario!
features: 71% Polyester, 29% Spandex
Made in the USA or Imported

COMFORT: Polar Verity Sense keeps your wrist free for maximum comfort and freedom of movement. Just slip it on your upper or lower arm, clip it on your goggles or place it snug and firm against your skin under tight-fitting clothing.
CONVENIENCE: With only one button, using Polar Verity Sense couldn't be easier. Just switch it on and put it on your arm or temple and you’re ready to start your workout right away.
CONNECTIVITY: Bluetooth and ANT plus guarantee a large variety of devices that you can connect Polar Verity Sense with. You can have two simultaneous Bluetooth connections.
